Super Shield Trigger
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may draw 2 cards. If you do, discard 2 cards from your hand.
S When you put this creature into the battle zone, choose up to 2 spells that cost 4 or less from your graveyard and cast them for no cost.

S このクリーチャーがバトルゾーンに出た時、自分の墓地からコストが４以下の呪文を2枚まで選び、コストを支払わずに唱える。
